domains.name: The AI Talent Network
domains.blurb: People who work with AI, listed by verified skills: the models, frameworks, vector stores, and governance standards they have real experience with. Free to join, email-confirmed, privacy-first — members control their own profiles and every save publishes at the next site build. The online application (sign-up and profile form) is at theworldofai.org/talent/join/ — apply there, or sign in to an existing profile at theworldofai.org/talent/login/. Each member gets a public resume page, downloadable ATS-safe PDF and Word versions, and weekly job matches from company hiring boards.

sections.name: Cloud GPU and Compute Telemetry
sections.blurb: What can be lawfully measured about AI compute: quarterly capital expenditure from the seven companies whose capex is the buildout, read from their own XBRL facts on SEC EDGAR, plus GPU cloud service health and verified benchmark registries. Spot GPU availability has no public source - provider quota APIs report only one's own account - and this page says so rather than estimating.
